label: Evil eye
desc: A bloodshot slit-pupil eye whose iris and lids follow the pointer, blinking now and then and glancing about on its own on touch.
use: Behind a spooky hero, a 404 page or a security or monitoring panel (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Faulty terminal
desc: A glitching terminal screen: scrolling log lines, tearing bands with RGB split, corrupted characters, scanlines and a blinking prompt; the pointer scrambles the lines under it.
use: Behind an error page, a developer-tool hero or a system-status section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Ferrofluid
desc: Glossy black magnetic liquid puddles drifting about, with a lattice of sharp spikes that rises where a magnet (the pointer) is near.
use: Behind a bold hero or a product reveal (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent). Falls back to a static CSS rendering without WebGL.

label: Floating lines
desc: Many thin gradient lines swaying across the width on slow waves with glowing beads drifting along them; lines bend away from the pointer.
use: Behind a calm landing hero or a pricing section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Flux lines
desc: Magnetic field lines traced between moving poles with pulses flowing along them; the pointer acts as a pole that bends the field.
use: Behind a technical or science-flavoured hero, a network or energy product page (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Galaxy
desc: A spiral galaxy of a couple of thousand stars with a glowing core, tilted in 3D and slowly rotating; the pointer tips the disc.
use: Behind a landing hero, a launch or space-themed section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent). Dark space in dark themes, a pale star chart in light ones.

label: Ghost fibers
desc: Pale fibres rising from the bottom edge like optical strands, swaying on slow waves, ending in soft glowing tips; the pointer blows them aside.
use: Behind a quiet hero, a footer or a network or connectivity section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Gradient ASCII
desc: ASCII art shaded by an animated gradient: each character cell picks a glyph by density and is tinted from the primary to the signal colour; the pointer raises a rippling bloom.
use: Behind a developer-tool, terminal-flavoured or retro hero (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Gradient blinds
desc: A row of vertical blinds filled with a drifting brand gradient; slats swing on a travelling wave and the ones near the pointer turn to face it.
use: Behind a bold hero, a feature banner or a section divider (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Gradient waves
desc: Layered filled waves blending the signal colour into the primary, rolling in from the bottom with bright crests; the pointer lifts a swell and slides the layers in parallax.
use: Behind a landing hero or a footer (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).
